description:
Weight is stepper-only at plus or minus 5 lb, so reaching 225 lb from the 45 lb default is 36 taps. Distance and duration already accept typed entry through DraftInput, which holds raw keystrokes until they parse; extend it to weight.

The lastWeight pre-fill already covers any exercise with history, so the flat 45 default only survives for a genuinely new exercise, which is exactly the case where typing matters most.
title: Type a weight instead of stepping to it
